surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions during plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition (PEALD) of Ga2O3 involve the interaction of trimethylgallium (TMG) with oxygen plasma. The mechanism includes the formation of surface hydroxyl groups, followed by the reaction of TMG with these groups to form gallium oxide. The plasma step generates atomic oxygen and energetic ions, which contribute to the crystallinity and phase control of the deposited films.
